D/ [ ] PF AVG ; R/ VICT [ ] AVG DD [ ] NN

Rally ID: 79(b). Roman coin: A complete struck / hammered copper alloy nummus of Constans (333 to 350 AD), of reverse type VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN (Two Victories facing each other, each holding a wreath), minted in Trier between 347 and 348 AD. Obverse: Rosette diadem, head facing right. Obverse inscription: [ ] PF AVG. Reverse: Two Victories facing each other, each holding a wreath. Upside down…
